query:
UPDATE saved_list
           SET name = NULL, filter = NULL, revision = revision + 1,
               deleted_at = now(), updated_at = now(),
               sort_key = NULL, sort_direction = NULL
           WHERE id = $1
             AND organization_id = $2
             AND deleted_at IS NULL
             AND revision = $3
             AND (scope = 'shared' OR created_by_user_id = $4)
